rows.name: Question2Answer
rows.reason: Question2Answer fits the PHP/MySQL Q&A foundation with participation features/extensions. No mandatory violation; complete plugin combination, exact attachments/reporting and February 2014 coverage remain unverified.

rows.name: Discourse
rows.reason: Deployable Q&A supports Post Voting, Gamification and Math; no mandatory prohibition stated. Retain version-specifically; multilingual behavior, upload rules, weekly-answer reporting and combined configuration need verification.

rows.name: Questionary
rows.reason: A Python library for interactive command-line prompts; it provides no hosted Q&A forum, user community, reputation system or moderation workflow.

rows.name: Question2Answer Badges plugin
rows.reason: Q2A plugin adds configurable badges, notifications and profile/post displays. README labels it beta; compatibility and availability before the question date remain unestablished.

rows.name: AnswerHub
rows.reason: AnswerHub documents attachments/reporting as a paid comparator. Pricing, licensing, support, affordability, math, multilingual behavior and implementation access remain unverified; current docs do not establish 2014-02-28 features or cost justification.

rows.name: Drupal Answers
rows.reason: Modular CMS Q&A integrates acceptance, voting, reputation and tags. Requires integration; current page warns of incompatible versions and no supported stable releases. Features lack cutoff dating.

rows.name: Discourse
rows.reason: Open-source forum supplies attachments, localization, admin statistics, permissions and plugins before the cutoff; a Q&A adaptation remains necessary, so retain it as a secondary option.

rows.name: Question2Answer
rows.reason: Question2Answer's PHP/MySQL core fits; plugins do not prove combined requirements. Language behavior, attachments/reports/equations/effort remain unverified; security/scalability claims provide no assurance. February 2014 features unestablished.

rows.name: AnswerHub
rows.reason: Commercial Q&A offers badges/reputation, permissions, moderation and REST/plugins. Price/full fit unverified; require demonstrations of math editing, languages, attachments and reporting before purchase evaluation.

rows.name: Askbot
rows.reason: Askbot's Python/Django Q&A has 2023/2026 feature evidence, not proof of 2014 implementations. Multilingual/report/attachment/math behavior needs version checks; scalability, security and development-time comparisons remain unestablished.

rows.name: Q2A WYSIWYG Math Editor
rows.reason: CKEditor-based Q2A extension supplies visual formula editing and MathJax rendering. Inspected implementation has later 2019 evidence; verify editor/MathJax compatibility with the selected Q2A version.

rows.name: Askbot
rows.reason: Askbot offers open-source Python/Django Q&A. The 2013 package has old runtime/database constraints; current badges, math, attachments and analytics must not be assumed historically available.

rows.name: Question2Answer
rows.reason: Question2Answer provides PHP/MySQL Q&A, roles and extension points. Badges/richer math need plugins; arbitrary attachments and weekly analytics require verification/development. Scaling/security claims were not independently tested.

rows.name: Questionary
rows.reason: Questionary provides Python command-line input prompts, not a multiuser web Q&A application. Asking terminal questions does not establish the requested community-platform role.
